note: DAILY-1 (Mark 2026-10-08 11:29 ET): the public site publishes every day a newer Velocity snapshot exists than the one live on the site. The box loop polls Hugging Face latest.json every poll_minutes between poll_window_et (ET). A snapshot is published only if complete: its .gz sha256 matches latest.json, the file holds every row latest.json claims, rows >= min_rows_ratio x the last published snapshot's rows, panel >= min_panel_ratio x the last published panel, and gates (if present) are all true. Otherwise it is logged and skipped. The niche price snapshot (paid Apify run) keeps its weekly cadence: niche_weekday at/after niche_time_et, at most once a day, when the newest niche cut is >= niche_cadence_days-3 days old.
